faqs.question: I am not technical. Can I still do this?
faqs.answer: Yes. I wrote every step so you can follow along even if you have never built a workflow before. 35 of the 36 setups need zero code. The single advanced setup is optional, so you can leave it for later.

faqs.question: I have tried AI tools before and got overwhelmed. Will this be different?
faqs.answer: That is exactly who I made this for. I tell you what to do first: one pain, one setup, one week. You are not meant to open all 36 at once.

faqs.question: I do not have time. How long does each setup take?
faqs.answer: Most setups take 10 to 30 minutes. Open one tonight and you will see for yourself how many hours you get back this week.

faqs.question: Do I need to pay for any monthly AI tools?
faqs.answer: Most setups run on the free tiers of tools you already use. If a specific workflow needs a paid plan, the setup page tells you upfront and gives you the free option first wherever it exists.

faqs.question: Is my Gmail, Drive, and bank alert data private?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100%. You are connecting your own accounts directly to each other. Your emails, spreadsheets, and files stay inside your private Google, Notion, and AI workspace. I never have access to your data.

faqs.question: Will this work for my 9-to-5 job or my business in Nigeria?
faqs.answer: Yes. Whether you are managing reports and project tasks at your day job or tracking Naira bank alerts and client orders in your business, the templates plug straight into your daily workflow.

faqs.question: What does founding member mean?
faqs.answer: You are joining while the group is small, so you get direct help from me. The first {founding_cap} founding members also get a 1-on-1 onboarding call. The kit price goes up to {price_was} later, and the community will become a paid monthly membership. Founding members never pay a monthly fee.

faqs.question: What if I get stuck on a step?
faqs.answer: You are not on your own. Bring your screen to our weekend Fix-It live class and we will solve it together, or drop a message inside the private community.

faqs.question: How does the Connect-It Guarantee work?
faqs.answer: You have a full {guarantee_days} days to test the kit. If a workflow will not connect, email me a short screen recording of the steps you took. I will help you fix it first. If we still cannot get it working, I will refund 100% of your {price_now}, send you {guarantee_bonus} extra for your time, and let you keep the kit.

faqs.question: What happens if an app changes its buttons or menus?
faqs.answer: Apps update their screens often. Whenever a menu changes, I update the instructions inside your dashboard and post the update on the New This Week page.

faqs.question: How do I receive the kit after paying?
faqs.answer: Right after payment, you get an automated email with your direct link to the 36-setup dashboard and your private community invite. You can open it immediately on your laptop or phone.

faqs.question: Can I share the kit with a colleague or friend?
faqs.answer: Your access link is for one person. However, you get your own partner link. Ask for it in the community after you join. Every friend or colleague who joins through your link earns you a 30% partner share ({partner_per} per sale at today's price).
